title: test(cli): migrate-meta e2e replays only the conversions step 17 still registers
body:
Fixes #27114

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 只改了 `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta.e2e.test.ts` 这一个夜间 e2e 测试文件。fixture 换成第 17 步仍注册的 12 个 conversion 各一处写法；#9418 那组用例改用仍有墓碑的 `agent.lifecycle` 和 `dashboard.refreshInterval`。
- **为什么改:** #26599 让 16.x 的 45 个 conversion 随退役套件老化离开第 17 步，`--from 16` 不再改写这些写法，快照里留下未知键，夜间 tiers 因此 6 个用例变红；PR 和合并队列不跑 e2e 层，所以只在夜间暴露。
- **风险与回滚:** 只动测试，不动产品代码，不发布任何东西。用例数不变（19 个），没有跳过、改名或换层。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** ① 该文件里的 `PRE17_CONFIG` 和 `EXPECTED_CONVERSIONS`；② 新增的注册表钉子（`EXPECTED_CONVERSIONS` 必须等于 `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[17].conversionIds`）；③ #9418 那组的 fixture 和 `os validate` 断言。
- **两分钟验证:** 先建好 cli 的依赖闭包，再跑 `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta.e2e.test.ts`，预期 19 个全部通过。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

#26599 (`dbf7e04adf`, ruling 6434038284 on #25767) removed the 45 conversions retired at 16.1.0 from step 17's `conversionIds`. It re-pointed the unit-tier cli pins but not this file, which runs only under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`. The 2026-10-28 nightly (run 40638682260) went red on six of its cases.

All six failures come from that narrowing:

- The main fixture carried one shape per 16.x conversion family. Nine of the ten families it expected are no longer registered, and `--from 16` leaves those shapes as written. So the run attributes nothing to them, and the snapshot keeps `responsive`, `performance`, `aria` and `defaultSort` as unknown keys. That breaks `schemaValid`, the per-family attribution, the `--out` re-parse and idempotence.
- The #9418 fixture carried `agent.knowledge` and `skill.triggerPhrases`. Their tombstones and conversions left the spec with the 16.x kits, so the load no longer converts them, and `os validate` answers with the strict unknown-key refusal that names the protocol upgrade guide, not the retired-key prescription.

The fix is in this one file. No case is added, removed, renamed or skipped, so the count stays at 19.

- **Main fixture:** the aged-out shapes are dropped (option (a) on the claim). The fixture now carries one shape for each of the 12 conversions step 17 still registers: the sharing-rule `full` → `edit` rename, the seven flow-node aliases and lifts (crud `object`, notify, wait, connector, map, subflow, script), `mongo` → `mongodb`, the converged retry policy (`retryDelayMs` → `backoffMs`), the page-header `description` → `subtitle` alias and the inline api action's object-form `params` → `bodyExtra`. The list was read from `registry.ts.template` step 17, not from memory, and every id was checked against `conversions/registry.ts`. The `required` / no-`storage` assertions (#16693), the canonical `delete_record` pass-through and the #4247 `maxRetries` TODO stay.
- **Registry pin:** the attribution case first asserts that `EXPECTED_CONVERSIONS` equals `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[17].conversionIds` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/migrations`, as `migrate-meta-default-range-window.test.ts` does). The next family that leaves or joins the step then reds here by name, not as a missing rewrite.
- **#9418 fixture:** re-pointed to retired keys whose tombstone and conversion still stand. `defineAgent` carries `lifecycle` (`agent-lifecycle-removed`), and `Dashboard.create` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` carries `refreshInterval` (`dashboard-refresh-interval-to-refresh-interval-seconds`). Both are protocol 18, which `--from 16` replays into. This is the same pair #26599 used when it re-pointed `migrate-meta-write.test.ts`. There are still two per-artifact helpers from spec subpaths, so a tolerance scoped to `defineStack` alone still fails it. The `os validate` half now matches the tombstone's own prescription, `--from 17`.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Option (a), not (b).** If an aged-out shape were kept, the replayed snapshot would be schema-invalid by design. That would break the `schemaValid`, re-parse and idempotence cases that the 12 surviving families need, and asserting the refusal instead would need a separate fixture and a new case. The ruled refusal itself, the unknown-key message naming the upgrade guide, was observed while reproducing this failure (the nightly log's `os validate` output). The spec owns the unit pins for it.
2. **Wider family coverage than before.** Before the narrowing, the file covered one step-17 family that still survives: sharing-rule. It now covers all 12 that step 17 registers, which restores the docblock's stated purpose: "one key from every v17 conversion family in a single pass".

## Tests

At head `f73c11c8` (this branch, merged with `origin/main` `6817bf1ea`):

- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta.e2e.test.ts`: before the fix, at `d90657b2`, `Tests 6 failed | 13 passed (19)`, the same six the nightly names. After: `Tests 19 passed (19)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: 341 of 343 files and 4929 tests passed, 29 skipped. The two remaining files (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refused before any test because cli's own `dist/` was not built. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` both passed (29 tests).
